newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BTR Dunlop sells unit for 23 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: BTR Dunlop sells unit for 23 mln rand.

text.p: BTR Dunlop Ltd said on Wednesday that it had sold its Dunlop Slazenger division (DSSA) to British-based international sports equipment group Dunlop Slazenger for 23 million rand.
Mike Smithyman, managing director of BTR Dunlop, said in a statement the sale was in line with the group's strategy to focus on industrial and engineering businesses.
The proceeds would be used to finance further group expansion in South Africa, he added.

Dunlop Slazenger chief executive David Jacobs said the group had acquired DSSA "to continue its strategy of building a global sports equipment group by extending the group's brand control and territorial coverage."
He said this was the first acquisition by the group since its management buy-out from BTR plc in March this year.
